goal: Choose a measured preview/final budget and inspect a real camera render
preconditions: Only change settings authorized for that target or use an isolated copy
code:

s=bpy.context.scene;assert s.camera is not None
result={'engine':s.render.engine,'camera':s.camera.name,'resolution':[s.render.resolution_x,s.render.resolution_y,s.render.resolution_percentage],
 'view_transform':s.view_settings.view_transform,'cycles_samples':s.cycles.samples,'adaptive':s.cycles.use_adaptive_sampling,'denoising':s.cycles.use_denoising}
steps: Check exposure, contact shadow, material separation and missing resources
Use render_thumbnail_to_path for previews up to320px, render_viewport_to_path for the scene-camera final render
Use an isolated durable job for longer renders; set explicit resolution/samples and measure elapsed time
Open the original final image and correct visible defects in the scene, then rerender
checks: No unacceptable noise or lost fine detail at delivery size
Saved .blend and final image belong to the same accepted revision
limits: No universal sample count guarantees quality
A rendered file or color-range statistic is not perceptual acceptance
CPU/GPU speed must be measured in the real scene/device
Static RNA enum_items may be empty for dynamic device choices; inspect actual devices and test execution
validation: Render inspection code executed; camera renders and OptiX configuration tested in isolated processes on X. Device/performance is machine and scene specific.

configure_optix_code:
import bpy
# Only in an isolated task process after an OptiX device is detected. Never save_userpref.
prefs=bpy.context.preferences.addons['cycles'].preferences
prefs.compute_device_type='OPTIX';prefs.get_devices()
assert any(d.type=='OPTIX' for d in prefs.devices),'No OptiX device available'
for device in prefs.devices: device.use=(device.type=='OPTIX')
bpy.context.scene.cycles.device='GPU'
result={'backend':'OPTIX','devices':[d.name for d in prefs.devices if d.use]}

measured_example.scope: One static product scene; construction and rendering measured separately
measured_example.quality: CPU and OptiX renders inspected at delivery resolution; tiny numerical differences, no material visual defect observed
